notes.title: We’re re-releasing Garden of the Sea in a non-VR version later this year!!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!!

We revealed some super duper exciting news at the Wholesome Direct this weekend: Garden of the Sea is getting a non-VR version!! 

We know some folks have been eyeing our game, which was originally released in 2019, but don’t play in VR, or have wanted to share this game with friends who don’t have VR. We also know that we’ve gotten such a lovely reception on our cozy farming sim that it felt like a waste of an opportunity to not try making it playable for way more people. So behold: later this year, we’re releasing Garden of the Sea, with all of its original features and charms, on Steam! It will have mainstream controller support, and SteamDeck compatibility, so you can just sit back and relax while fishing, watering your plants, or petting the native creatures that live on your island.

We hope you’ve enjoyed a look at our game that’s chock full of fun things to do and relaxing vibes (which we could all certainly use more of during these times)! Please feel free to wishlist it if you like what you see (it helps indies out a lot) and follow us on our socials! 

Talk to you soon!

notes.title: Ready For Release Early 2022
notes.notes:
Hi again everyone!

We're back and we're looking as fancy as ever as we're finally ready to share that sweet release window of ours!

You've probably noticed that we have given the Steam Store page an overhaul which will remain with us until launch. This means new videos, new screenshots and new store text. Phew! What do you think? We would love to hear your thoughts.

But first, let's recap what we announced during the UploadVR Showcase!

We're also launching on Quest 2
You who watched the UploadVR Showcase with us might also have heard we've decided to include the Oculus Quest 2 as one of our launch platforms. Some of you may already have guessed this, but we hope you're just as excited as us that we're finally joining the Quest family (because we know a lot of you have been asking for this for some time now ♥)!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/ef6e6f9cf07399e908ad6d01596f9959385f4dff.png
Missed the UploadVR Showcase?
Fear not! You can see our spot bellow and get a preview of how the game will look on Oculus Quest 2:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3d-v6Erxkyc
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/ef6e6f9cf07399e908ad6d01596f9959385f4dff.png

PCVR is still getting the love it deserves
We know most of you here on Steam are only here for the PCVR version and we're working on a trailer for you all as well which will showcase what the game will look at launch for you (and perhaps a comparison? We hear those are all the rage these days!).

But that will probably not reach you all until later in December and we know you all are dying to see what we have in store, so in the meantime; Have some of our more current PCVR screenshots. Hype!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/01f8c577056933e86430eb8bec2c5d17872048d0.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/bf89c983d68728b8303fbcb3c0a89732fde34272.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/ed2c3e38d3fdc5a63599bd9d3bf70fd0f91b844c.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/f7583fd6cd9f1b9dcd20e85767ddac8268217f42.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/ea2798ecbf7558840276df55dd38b0cdb9ff3f22.png


Now, let's get into what you're all actually here for:

Garden of the Sea will launch soon! Like 2022 soon!
First of all, the quick facts and details:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/ef6e6f9cf07399e908ad6d01596f9959385f4dff.png
When? Very early 2022
Where? Steam for PC VR with Vive, Index or Rift, and Oculus Quest 2
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/ef6e6f9cf07399e908ad6d01596f9959385f4dff.png

What happens next? 
We are currently going through rigorous QA, fixing bugs and continuing to polish all the little things. Releasing on both PC VR and Oculus Quest 2 means a bigger potential player base, which in turn means we can keep updating and adding to the game for longer! In addition, we are put to more intense scrutiny when it comes to bugs and playability, ultimately leading to a better game for everyone. We consider this a real win-win. 

Localization & Accessibility
The game is extensively localized and can be played standing or sitting down, in big or small play spaces, lowering the threshold of entry for as many prospective players as possible. The game allows for teleportation, smooth locomotion, smooth and snap turn, all at adjustable speeds. Audio is highly encouraged, but not required!

Languages available are, in alphabetical order: Arabic, Chinese (simplified and traditional), Danish, Dutch, English, Finnish, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Persian, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil and Portugal), Russian, Spanish, Swedish and Turkish.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/ef6e6f9cf07399e908ad6d01596f9959385f4dff.png


As we get even closer to launch, we are preparing a bunch of fun events and raffles for both old and new faces! Stickers? T-shirts? Mugs? What would you like to see?

As always we're available both here on Steam and on our own Neat community Discord server and we're always listening, so don't be afraid to say hi!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/5c53bb6ddcfc8469d52eeddb56980c245348c3ec.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/1d8064a38e666c295ec967fa1376a5de11c07876.png Talk again soon! <3

// With love from all of the Neat GotS team

notes.title: New island update out now!
notes.notes:
Great news gardeners, the new island is finally here!

We've done loads of tweaking and re-planning and we've finally reached a place where we're happy to consider it ready for Early Access.

We want to start with giving a quick shout-out to everyone who joined in and tested while we worked on this update on the Experimental Branch. Your feedback has been invaluable and we hope you've enjoyed watching this island take shape as much as we loved building it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/c3ac9d2b6b455fb0052996c45b3e1b3af1a35dcb.png
This patch contains changes that will break your save files!

Due to the complexity of the changes made while adding a whole new island we've unfortunately have had to implement changes that will break your current save files.

Even if they might load for you, many features might be broken on old save files and we can’t guarantee that all the game systems will function correctly. We strongly recommend that you start a new game to ensure that everything works as intended.

Breaking saves like this is sadly one of the risks of early access and we are doing our best to avoid it, but at times it can’t be helped. Thanks for bearing with us!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/ef6e6f9cf07399e908ad6d01596f9959385f4dff.png


Now, without further ado; say hello to Crystal Island!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/11530244161892deb0089bac2667756112d5b77b.png

Uncover the secrets of Crystal Island
Just a bit off the coast of your home island you'll find this new mystical island covered with hot springs, red crowned trees and some naturally growing crystals scattered about. The environment here is harsh as an invasive moss covering the ground makes it hard for crops to find space to grow. If you find a patch with tillable soil you'll find that the minerals present will give the plants new and unique colors, so trying to find ways to sustain your plants here may be quite worth your while.

With Crystal Island you'll also find a new quest chain focused on environmental puzzles and unlocking new abilities. Watch and listen to the land around you and find your way to the center of the island where you'll find the first glimpse of the history of this ancient world.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/91da631ecb7c560e38a02ede9ff6808053b29400.png

Travel faster and further with the new Crystal Teleport feature
Use the crystals on Crystal Island to upgrade your gloves, unlocking the power to quickly move from crystal to crystal and allowing you to teleport further than ever before. Use your wits and uncover new recipes and materials that will allow you to bring this newfound ability back to your home island.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/cc5a03740d4a19946878d573ae037f4402973dba.png
Meet new animal friends
With this new island we're also introducing a new animal. Native to the Crystal Island and with a love for all things shiny, these fellas know how to live in style!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/ef6e6f9cf07399e908ad6d01596f9959385f4dff.png
Want to help give this little fellow a name?

We love involving our community in the decision process and we see this as a great opportunity to hold another naming contest! Get yourself ready and keep your eyes peeled as we'll post an update for each phase of the contest with all the info on how to join.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/887bf3ea9fd1d708a8e64c8d5d8a075722c7af79.png

Contest Phase 2 is live! Join it below:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1086850/view/3030333493798251294

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/dfe7fc4ff7d33e2e4e810a0aebf8d8ed940d11ea.png

Spring has arrived
With this update we're also leaving the white frosty grass behind to move into the greener horizons of spring. We've heard many of you have been looking forward to the end of winter so I think this will be some welcome news for you. :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/1cdf281b596082247af5abc05094322dd7b17f6a.png

What else is new?
We've also added new fish types, new resources, tools, craftable items and more! Among the highlights you'll find that you can now craft a grass seed bag which will allow you to re-grow grass on previously tilled soil. We've also added a craftable water pump which will make the chore of refilling your watering can much less cumbersome.

We've added a full patch note list at the very bottom of this post for you who love to stay in the know but you're also always welcome to jump in blind and uncover all the new features as you go. Regardless of method we hope you'll enjoy what you'll see!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/ef6e6f9cf07399e908ad6d01596f9959385f4dff.png


That's it for this update! Remember to keep your eyes peeled for the next post launching our naming contest. It should be up in a day or so.

And as always: your thoughts, ideas and feedback are always welcome. You can always reach us here directly on Steam or join our official Discord server to get first access to the latest news and community events.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/5c53bb6ddcfc8469d52eeddb56980c245348c3ec.png


With love,
// The Neat GotS team

notes.title: Merchant Update Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hello gardeners!

We are excited to announce that the Merchant Update has officially been released! With it comes house upgrades, an updated plant system, a composting box and a sweet bunch of new decoration items for both your garden and your home. But that’s not all! Read on for a deep dive into each new feature or scroll all the way to the bottom for the full patch notes.

But first, a small (but actually rather large) notice:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/ef6e6f9cf07399e908ad6d01596f9959385f4dff.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/cf952ff5db20cb3c2d7aa4b4cb8d82ba40b11b33.png
This patch contains changes that will break your save files!

Major changes to gameplay systems made for the Merchant Patch will render your previously saved game sessions incompatible with the new update. Even if they might load for you, many features might be broken on old save files and we can’t guarantee that all the game systems will function correctly. We strongly recommend that you start a new game file to ensure that everything works as intended.

Breaking saves like this is sadly one of the risks of early access and we are doing our best to avoid it, but at times it can’t be helped. Thanks for bearing with us!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/ef6e6f9cf07399e908ad6d01596f9959385f4dff.png

With that out of the way, let’s move on to the sweet new stuff we’re giving you!

The Merchant has arrived
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/bcd9ef3dab62300864e94ab0fe2c3d1c82c5dd35.gif
The Merchant has finally woken up from his nap and he’s here to stay! Be sure to swing by for a look at what’s in stock regularly, because he likes to update his stock with new items every day!

On the Merchant’s trading ship you’ll use your farmed resources to trade for a long range of items and decorations that will allow you to further personalize your island. The Merchant stocks everything from alarm clocks to pots. He even carries pattern rolls which will enable you to update the fabric of your curtains and pillows, allowing you to max out your house decoration game even further!

Upgrade your home from a simple tent to the home of your dreams
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/fa82e70489a2dd4cc353158ed568ea93afe9a533.png
For all your living needs we’ve added a li'l questline for upgrading your house from a humble tent into a cozy cabin which has more room and wall-space for storage and decorating! In the largest home you can also customize the colors of the walls, floors and roof using the Jellyfish painting blobs, so go wild!

Clean up that mess with new storage solutions
Is your island as messy as mine? Are seed bags scattered all over the floor and is there a pile of long forgotten harvested vegetables resting at the bottom of the pond? With the new storage solutions we’re adding it will be easier than ever to organize your items!

After you’ve upgraded your home, you’ll find a neat little chest that can store items in bubbles similar to the ones in your inventory. We’ve also added additional shelves with similar storage capacities.

For you who like to keep your items out on display there are also some regular shelves and tables you can craft (or buy) for keeping your home nice and tidy.

Show your garden some extra love with the new compost
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/f93d18120e4d7f37d032cd2c9ebbb6b658b1be51.png
Next to your home we have now placed a neat little composting unit which will allow you to convert green plants into useful fertilizer.  You can then use the fertilizer on tilled soil to increase plant growth speed and reduce the amount of water the plants need to fully grow.

Sounds super sweet if you ask me!

Plant system rework
Gardening is a huge part of our game and of course it hasn’t missed out on our love in this update. We have made a complete overhaul to the plant system which will result in better performance along with opening up new doors for us to implement new features such as wind (to come in the future), smoother growth and new potential interactions.

Some examples of the changes you’ll notice in this update is that plants now consume water as they grow and the growing process has been slowed down to more closely represent the intended feel of the final game. You’ll also notice it will be a bit easier to harvest resources from fully grown plants without uprooting them completely as they now need to be tilled in order to be completely uprooted.

Our clever gardening magician Oliver has promised to dive deeper into this overhaul in a later post, so stay tuned!

Capture and display memories with the new in-game camera
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/6b093d7da40e251f65884d8230d5eea159067dee.jpg
Your tool shed has now been expanded and includes a nifty little instant camera. Pick it up, snap some photos of your best friends and hang them up on display in your newly upgraded house.

If you ever feel like sharing your photos outside the game you can find them stored in the ‘Data’ folder in your Garden of the Sea save folder. It’s usually located in one of the numbered folders within ‘%USERPROFILE%\\AppData\\LocalLow\\Neat Corporation\\Garden of the Sea\\Saves’ (boy, that was a mouthful).

New - smoother - ways to move around
You asked for it - and we listened! Smooth locomotion along with more options regarding snap turning has been added to the game in this update, so if you’re one of those cool cats that like to glide rather than teleport you’ll now be able to do so (you still need to teleport up steep hills though).

You can turn this on along with fine tuning your movement speed and acceleration from the Settings tab in the in-game menu.

[SEASONAL] Fall has arrived to all islands
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/a3c9da00c331ae4ead61812cef92d549ad07c620.png
Do you love Fall as much as we do? Does the Halloween season always put a wide smile on your face? Then you’re gonna love the fact that you can now enjoy the beautiful season of fall in Garden of the Sea! You’ll also find some sweet Halloween themed decorations which you can place around your garden and home. We hope you’ll enjoy this feature as much as we do!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/ef6e6f9cf07399e908ad6d01596f9959385f4dff.png

That’d be all for this time folks! If you want to get down into the nitty-gritty we’re also providing a full patch note list at the very bottom, but as always we’re loving the engagement and love you are showing, so keep the feedback coming! ♥️

Feel free to join the Neat Corp Discord if you haven’t already to share your thoughts, additional feedback or want to make us aware of any bugs you’ve encountered.

Until next time,
// The Neat GotS team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/ef6e6f9cf07399e908ad6d01596f9959385f4dff.png

FULL PATCH NOTES
New Features

notes.title: Merchant Patch Out On the Experimental Branch Now!
notes.notes:
Hello again gardeners!

We are happy to announce the launch of the Merchant patch onto our Experimental Branch! If you have time to go test it out, please do!

Since this is the Experimental Branch, please be aware that some bugs are expected and that there’s an increased risk of game breaking situations occurring. This branch is mostly for all of you who want to try all the newest things and help us out with making everything as awesome as possible for the main branch release!

How to switch to the Experimental Branch:
Note: Exact names of the options to press might differ depending on your Steam language settings.
[olist]
 Right click 'Garden of the Sea' in your Steam Library list and select 'Properties...'
 Go the tab 'BETAS'
 In the drop-down menu, select "experimental - Development branch"
 The game should then start an update in order to download the new branch
 When the update is finished, just run the game and start playing!
[/olist]
Remember: If you later want to go back to the regular branch you will have to repeat the above steps and re-select "NONE - Opt out of all beta programs".

BE AWARE: Major save file changes will render your previous saves incompatible with the new update
This patch is sadly not going to be compatible with your earlier saves. Even if they might load for you, many features might be broken and we can’t guarantee what the experience might be. We strongly recommend that you create a new save to ensure that everything works as intended.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/c5c6d28f81a57bc144319645be63353ceb6e74e0.png

Let's dive into the full list of all the new systems and changes we've packed into this update:

Major Features
Merchant
He's finally awake! And boy is he happy to see you!

 Use your farmed resources to trade for new items in his shop!
 Allows you to acquire new decorations for your island
 Restocks daily so be sure to check for new items every day!


House Upgrades
Is tent life not your style? Have no fear! House upgrades are here!

 Start your adventure with a cozy tent
 Two house upgrades available through quests
 Each upgrade adds new types of items to the merchants store
 Unlock new customization opportunities as your house grows!


Plant System Rework
Plants are stealing the show with their new fancy system!

 Complete overhaul of the plant system back-end for future-proofing performance and scalability
 Growth cycle of plants is now completely smooth
 Major increase in performance, at least by an order of magnitude
 Plants now consume water as they grow, and the growth process has been slowed down to more closely represent the feel of the final game
 Caring for your plants is now made easier with fertilizer balls that can be acquired through the compost bin
 Plants that grow crafting resources will now need to be tilled in order to be completely uprooted
 Many other fixes and preparations for features will be arriving with future patches!


Smooth Locomotion
Smoooooth! Oh so smooth!

 After many requests it’s finally here, smooth locomotion is added to the game
 Smooth locomotion can be enabled through the in-game menu
 Multiple options to tailor movement to your liking!


Minor Features
Smaller (but just as neat!) systems for you to enjoy!

 In-game camera: Capture your favorite moments with our new instant camera!
 Compost bin: Consumes excess plants to generate fertilizer
 Pattern system: Further customize your fabrics with new patterns
 New Decoration items: Additional decor items for both your home and your garden have been added
 Storage: In-world storage items to alleviate inventory clutter
 Loading Screen: The game now has a loading screen
 Snap Turning: Snap turning was added alongside Smooth Locomotion for you who prefer a more snappy approach to movement
 [Seasonal] Fall: Fall is now here in the garden with updated foliage colors and seasonal plants and decor!


Do you have feedback on this patch?
We'd love to hear what you think about these updates! Feel free to fill in our Google Form about your experience!

If you come across any bugs or have any additional feedback about the new systems (or any of the old ones, for that matter!) we are as always available in our Neat Corp Discord channel!

notes.title: Fishing Patch out now!
notes.notes:
Gosh y’all - it’s been a while since we released a whole big patch for Garden of the Sea, but here we are with not one, not two, but three really big updates for you, bundled into one handy-dandy patch! We’d love to take a moment to tell you about all the juicy new code behind these updates, and what it means for you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/9fe4c1d841525c1d84573992b81e2c9831ac37e5.jpg


TLDR; 

 Fishing mechanic/gameplay added.
 Painting system for all crafted items.
 New quest to unlock the boat, painting system, and fishing rod.
 Save system rework.


At the beginning of 2020 we began work in earnest on reworking the system in Garden of the Sea which handles the Save Game data. This was a huge undertaking, since we quickly learned that we would need to create a save system which future-proofs (as much as possible) for future content updates, and doesn’t just save stuff that’s been built in the past. That way everyone who has bought and played the game in the past can easily open up a newer version of Garden of the Sea and their save data will be intact, their progress saved.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/f582a924571c80245d10b3ef36c47726db8ad415.png


Once that was done, work started on our Fishing Patch. Alongside this, we also began work on what we are calling the Painting System. Both of these systems are designed to broaden the interaction possibility with the other systems currently in-game, and provide little moments of fun and customization that we felt fit really well within this universe.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/c3448a911940199facbde4367312e630d3186130.gif


The painting system allows you to utilize the vibrant colors of several plants you’ve cultivated, mirroring their hues on any crafted item you have unlocked and built in the world. Make your house truly spectacular with bright purples and blues, or maybe set up a row of pastel fences around your precious radishes (you can never be too careful with those cheeky puffkins around). We really want to open up the door to even more customization and personalization in your garden, and making this island your home.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/848dd00ada75fb92585d169fb3af6c77fb8b0c7b.jpg


The fishing system was a natural extension of the in-game boat (our ode to smooth locomotion) and something that we always knew was going to exist in the game, but we were never sure exactly _how_ it would exist. Would you have a hook? Was the game easy with no skill-check? Was it difficult with no fail-state? Was it frustrating, or relaxing? In the end I think we landed on a good balance of the above, in large part thanks to the help and feedback of our wonderful Discord community. The fish also have a pond to help nurture the fishies you’ve found and brought home to your island.

So without further ado - here are the patch notes for this Fishing, Painting, and Save System update for Garden of the Sea:

Bigger stuff

 Save system overhaul (now built to be far more robust for future updates).
 Fishing mechanic first version implemented (yay!).
 Fish system for pools of fish in the ocean of varying types.
 Quest-line implemented for unlocking the boat.
 Painting system for customizing crafted items implemented.
 Quest-line added for paint blob recipes and functionality.


Smaller stuff

 New pot-pot animations added and implemented.
 Art polish and tweaks on several plant types and textures in-game.
 Fishing pond added near home to house new fishies.
 Fishing rod island for acquiring fishing rod implemented.
 Seagull creature added to indicate fish regions.
 Cave area added on back side of tallest island.
 Colors for all crafted items implemented.
 Colors for tools now implemented.
 New VFX for fishing, painting, and potpot anims implemented.
 Pre-populated planter box recipes added.
 Several new fish types added with dynamic fish colors for fishing system.
 Sound and music for new mechanics and systems implemented.
 Updated to latest version of gestrument.
 Rumble haptics fixed for most hardware.
 Index grabbing functionality tweaked to feel better.


Good to know
Save files are now saved in %userprofile%/AppData/LocalLow/Neat Corporation/Garden of the Sea/Saves instead of your Documents folder
It will not be possible to load your old save files, even if you copy them to the new directory

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/f90cd4bdd85a02d75569340c97fb9b95366941ec.gif

notes.title: Fishing Patch update, what's on the horizon, and a pricing update for Garden of the Sea!
notes.notes:
Bug-fixing and interaction tweaks are going strong over at our home-offices on the Fishing Patch for Garden of the Sea.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37700539/3ff37d54c3ee33dfa020ba53c00c48c636bbfdac.jpg

Meanwhile, a couple of our artists have started working on our next update: the Merchant Patch!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37700539/4dc8aaf8ebf1f6e3e841eb29482ea51446c93a3e.gif

The Merchant Patch is going to feature a trading system, which helps provide goals and value to the resources you are growing (beyond their creature-feeding and island-beautifying ones, of course!). For example, you’ll be able to trade flowers for a fancy new glove (perhaps one with an upgraded inventory!), splurge on that rare vase that goes perfectly on your newly crafted shelf, or save up a bunch of fruit to finally be able to trade for that new wallpaper you’ve been wanting. The traded items are meant to help enhance and evolve your growing, crafting and exploring and make them even more personal.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37700539/c89e1221e2cfa2e8f75e64ca19d9f464e1172c3f.jpg

We will also be adding in smooth locomotion, and a few other quality of life updates to make sure that we continue to support every type of player who wants to have their very own Garden of the Sea.

In the future, we want to add a deeper interaction system with the creatures, a day/night cycle, support for more hardware, more islands with new plants, quests, and recipes, along with new systems like wearables, breeding, cooking, and more. This list of things we want to build for Garden of the Sea is ever-growing and ever-changing with the feedback and conversations we have with all of you, our Early Access-ees (is that a word? It is now!) over on our discord channel. We’d love to hear from you if you have suggestions for future features or tweaks!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37700539/1512b4fbdd328658252dc6bbc44d743ccf479090.jpg

We’ve also taken the time now at Neat Corporation to look over our price points on all our titles, and are going to be adjusting them all very soon. Some will be reduced, while others will be raised. As we’ve written about previously, Garden of the Sea is going to increase with price with every large content update, and the Fishing Patch is one of them. With this patch we will be raising the price to $11.99 USD (€ 9.99 EUR). We plan on rolling out this new price in a couple weeks (most likely on June 1st) along with the release of the Fishing Patch on the public branch of the game. The new price is meant to not only reflect the amount of work that has gone into the game, but also help us get closer to what we believe the final selling price of the game will be once it goes out of Early Access.

Thank you for helping us get to this point, we can't wait to build what's coming up next alongside you all!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37700539/698c557a985d09d526f9bb421f45ff9dc33dc3b0.jpg

 Index grabbing functionality tweaked to feel better.
 Good to know
 Save files are now saved in %userprofile%/AppData/LocalLow/Neat Corporation/Garden of the Sea/Saves instead of your Documents folder
 It will not be possible to load your own save files, even if you copy them to the new directory


Known issues
 Loading screen doesn’t work properly
 Some plants might look strange/buggy when growing, since we are in the middle of reworking the plant system (but this will be fixed in an update soon)
 Fishing is currently not “explained” in any way, so we are hoping to get feedback from you all on which elements of the minigame are clear and which are confusing.


If you encounter issues with saving/loading:

Please zip the whole folder %userprofile%/AppData/LocalLow/Neat Corporation/Garden of the Sea and send it to support (at) neatcorporation (dot) com


❤ Thank you so much for all your wonderful feedback and support with Garden of the Sea so far! We really couldn't do this without you all ❤

notes.title: Fishing patch coming (soon)!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
I wanted to give you a lil peek into the work we've been doing on the upcoming Fishing patch for Garden of the Sea!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/f1db9c1f782e12de0f035f0814f65c0f73a17adc.gif

First things first - we made sure to add some fish.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/f582a924571c80245d10b3ef36c47726db8ad415.png

We've got several types of fish now, and variations within each type, so you will have plenty of fish in your sea! Each type of fish will create resources for you once you have put them in your pond. One of the resources that you can get is a lil jelly ball from the jellyfish (you dont wanna know how you get it... it just.... appears. trust me) which can then be used to craft paintballs for customizing all your crafted items! We're definitely gonna start seeing some wacky color combinations soon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/c3448a911940199facbde4367312e630d3186130.gif

It hasn't all been fun and games though - we have run into a few "happy little accidents" along the way, like that one time we accidentally got giant tomatoes when we were refactoring the plant growing code... 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/c3648cc77366a6c969aa98fb144e86aa7445dde0.jpg

or when we accidentally built Fortnite in VR...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/125a38fd0ce1d5dfc4075b87c3f24883ed30104e.gif

We have also been fixing a few smaller things you've been asking for though. For instance, if you toss an object into the water it will now (in most cases) float back to shore so you can grab it again. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/6ca0d9b0b6fcdcb70b2071c7bad54f6e3242f098.gif

We aren't done yet with all the tweaks to the fishing system, but we are gearing up for an open beta of that patch soon, and would love to get your feedback on it. If you'd like to give the new mechanics a try before they go live on the main branch on steam, join us over on our Neat Corp Discord! We look forward to chatting and hearing your thoughts and ideas.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/dfbbd0cc8c6175d73fb574450e34fa1435b36ce4.jpg

We can't wait to share fishing (and all the other updates this patch will contain) with you all! Stay tuned for the patch release, coming "soon" (when it's ready!).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/848dd00ada75fb92585d169fb3af6c77fb8b0c7b.jpg

Warmest wishes from the GotS team!



oh... and cat tax (one of our developers cats "tribble" attacking the new in-game seaguls)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/f90cd4bdd85a02d75569340c97fb9b95366941ec.gif

notes.title: Yule love this Garden of the Sea update!
notes.notes:
Earlier this fall we announced that we were pausing Garden of the Sea development in order to focus on finishing Budget Cuts 2: Mission Insolvency in time for release on December 12th (Which went really well! BC2 is out now and we are all so happy to see people playing it! whew!). While a few of us will continue to work on upcoming patches and updates for BC2, we will snow be shifting our focus as a studio over to Garden of the Sea(!!!!!)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/23be2a829a3375ad67d860f7d280be44c85bd6f6.png

We want to thank you all for your support and patience while we focused on Budget Cuts, but we are sooo excited to be jumping back over to Garden of the Sea and diving into development on the next set of mechanics and content. As always, we love your ideas for how to grow this game during its Early Access phase, so please share with us through our discord channel, or in the steam forum.

As a little treat we made a small winter themed seasonal update that is now live. Have fun in the snow and stay tuned for more updates coming next year!

notes.title: Patch #4 is live! - Bugfixes
notes.notes:
This patch contains the following bugfixes:
• Vive Pro controllers now work properly
• Fixed some issues with controller input in the menu
• Fixed a bug that caused grass to grow on tilled soil patches

notes.title: Patch #3 is live! - Haptics support
notes.notes:
• Added haptics for Oculus Rift and HTC Vive. Controllers will now rumble when tilling, chopping trees, interacting with creatures, plants and seedbags, running the boat into obstacles, and more!
* Added grab highlights on the crafting recipes.
• Tweaked plants so they look nicer while growing.
• Added instructional posters for Valve Index controllers.

notes.title: Patch #2 is live!
notes.notes:
Hello gardeners! We have uploaded a new build for Garden of the Sea on Steam, please try it out! 

What's new:
- Index and Knuckles first pass implementation
- More bugfixes related to saving/loading
- 2 new crafting recipes and 1 new flower type
- Improved watering can interaction

If you have any issues with saving and loading in this build, please upload your save files in #bugs over on our discord channel https://discord.gg/NeatCorp or at https://gots.userecho.com/. The save files are located in "C:/Users/YOURUSERNAME/Documents/Garden of the Sea Save Data"

Please be aware that due to the early access nature of the game, this update may break your current save files. We are sorry for the inconvenience and are working on a  more robust save system for the game.

Please don't hesitate to report bugs or make suggestions - we need your help to make this game the best it can be!

notes.title: First Patch!
notes.notes:
We made our first update to Garden of the Sea! Here's what was done:

- Fixed a major bug that caused saving and loading the game to fail
- Fixed a bug that made it possible to permanently lose crafting recipes
- Fixed a bug that caused some plants to float in the air when loading a save file

Please don't hesitate to report bugs or make suggestions - we need your help to make this game the best it can be!
